title: Empat Ulas Satu Durian
genre: barbershop quartet (four-part a cappella harmony, tags and swipes)
subject: four office mates split a single durian from a roadside stall and argue over who gets the biggest pod
caption: Barbershop quartet a cappella, four unaccompanied male voices in close four-part harmony with ringing chords, lead voice carrying the melody, tenor above, baritone below, bass anchoring on the roots. Swipes, tags and a held final chord. Dry intimate hall, no reverb wash, voices only. Warm mock-solemn delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 98 BPM, F major. Comic, warm mood. No instruments, no drums, no autotune, no rap, no synth pads.
lyrics:
[Intro - bass hums the root, three voices enter in harmony]

[Verse 1]
Empat orang kawan duduk bulat
Satu durian tengah meja plastik
Penjual hulur pisau, kami tenung
Kami buka, bau penuh gerai

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, empat ulas
Siapa dapat yang paling gemuk

[Chorus]
Empat ulas satu durian
Ambil adil, ambil adil
Yang besar itu, siapa punya
Empat ulas satu durian

[Verse 2]
Si Jamal kata, dia yang belanja
Si Wong kata, dia yang cari gerai
Si Raju kata, dia yang kupas
Aku kata, aku yang lapar

[Bridge - tenor and bass swap lines, tag]
Biji pun nak dibahagi
Siapa kalah, dia basuh tangan

[Chorus]
Empat ulas satu durian
Ambil adil, ambil adil
Yang besar itu, kami belah empat
Empat ulas satu durian

[Outro - tag, swipe up to a held chord]
Empat ulas, satu durian
